text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Combining lisinopril (an ACE inhibitor) with spironolactone (a potassium-sparing diuretic) increases the risk of hyperkalemia because potassium-sparing diuretics can elevate potassium levels [lisinopril:drug_interactions:1]. Therefore, if concomitant use is indicated, the patient's serum potassium should be monitored frequently [lisinopril:drug_interactions:1].
